lines.t: (Verse 1)
In the quiet, You are near,
Your gentle voice, all I hear.
The world fades, the noise is gone,
And in Your peace, I carry on.
You calm the ache inside my chest,
You lead me home, You give me rest.
Every breath, a gift of grace,
I find my strength within Your face.
(Chorus)
Heaven’s whisper, calling me,
Through the silence, I believe.
In Your mercy, I am whole,
You speak life into my soul.
Heaven’s whisper, tender light,
Guides me through the endless night.
Every heartbeat, every tear,
Reminds me, Lord, You’re always near.
(Verse 2)
When I wander far away,
Still, Your love won’t fade away.
Your hand reaches through the dark,
Reigniting every spark.
You lift the veil that hides my view,
And every step draws close to You.
You are truth, the great I Am,
The gentle voice, the spotless Lamb.
(Chorus)
Heaven’s whisper, calling me,
Through the silence, I believe.
In Your mercy, I am whole,
You speak life into my soul.
Heaven’s whisper, tender light,
Guides me through the endless night.
Every heartbeat, every tear,
Reminds me, Lord, You’re always near.
(Bridge)
You are peace, unshaken love,
The still small voice from up above.
Though the world may fade away,
Your whisper keeps my heart in place.
(Final Chorus)
Heaven’s whisper, calling me,
Softly shaping who I’ll be.
In Your presence, I belong,
Every breath becomes a song.
Heaven’s whisper, I am free,
You are all I’ll ever need.
Forever Yours, my heart will stay,
Your whisper leads the way.
